title: Movements And Things
description: A cool modpack by @vorxii made to improve vanilla minecraft through QOL features.
body:
>**_This modpack is inspired by actions and stuff from bedrock, this modpack imitates mostly everything from actions and stuff while still having its own touches._**
>
> **_Aims for a very immersive minecraft experience, this modpack has animation mods/resource packs, particle tweaks, sound tweaks, and adds many QOL features and well as visual improvements._** 
> 
>_This modpack is not optimization focused, so frames will be very low on most PCS._
>
